data.explanation: This is a private bill from an occupational therapy practice for your daughter's treatment, issued on a private prescription (Privatrezept) and exempt from VAT under §4 No. 14 UStG. You need to transfer €430.00 to the practice's bank account by the deadline shown, using the invoice number as reference if possible. The letter does not mention what happens if you pay late, but it's best to pay on time or contact the practice if you have questions, since health insurance reimbursement (if any) would be a separate process you'd need to pursue yourself.
